name: Quartus Relay
statsOrigin: Original contributor world · fixed discovery survey
lore: Four silver relay arcs rise above Quartus Relay's turquoise seas and basalt island chains. Its recovery crews preserve what the frontier would otherwise lose: eligible battles grant the holder the same 20% bonus salvage as Earth. The registry honours 4 of 7 · Primary Unimatrix001 with an original world and one charter per round; its holder keeps their chosen interface theme.
